name: @nusantara-ventures/exchangerate-mcp
stderr:
[@nusantara-ventures/exchangerate-mcp] EXCHANGERATE_API_KEY is required. Set it in your MCP client config:
  "env": { "EXCHANGERATE_API_KEY": "your-key-here" }
Get a key at https://exchangerate.dev/pricing — Free tier includes MCP access.
To allow anonymous (free-tier) access, also set ALLOW_ANONYMOUS=true.
